scopes.always_loaded: claude/CLAUDE.md, claude/rules/, claude/output-styles/ and the stance variant config.example.json selects, for the default selection
scopes.listings: one description line per agent, skill and command the session lists
scopes.worst_case_est_tokens: the same files with the longest variant of every stance dimension
scopes.files: each always-loaded and listed file on its own, the same set `total` sums; its est_tokens are rounded per file, so they sum to the total within rounding
scopes.note: `harness lint` counts a narrower set against its caps: instructions, rules and the longest stance variant, with no output style and no listings
